functions.name: local_jobboard_should_show_menu
functions.description: Check if the jobboard menu should be visible for the current user. The menu is visible if: There are open convocatorias, OR the user has one of the custom jobboard roles, OR the user is a site admin.
functions.return_description: True if menu should be visible.

functions.name: local_jobboard_extend_navigation
functions.description: Adds navigation nodes to the main navigation. This function adds Job Board to both: 1) The Moodle navigation drawer (side navigation) and 2) The main navigation menu (custom menu items in top bar). VISIBILITY: Menu is only shown if there are open convocatorias, OR user has a custom jobboard role (reviewer, coordinator, dean, hr), OR user is a site admin. Navigation Structure includes: Dashboard, Public Vacancies (if enabled), Available Vacancies, My Applications, Management Section (for managers), Review Section (for reviewers), Reports, and Settings.

functions.name: local_jobboard_extend_settings_navigation
functions.description: Adds settings to the site admin menu. Note: The admin pages are registered in settings.php using admin_externalpage, which automatically adds them to the Moodle admin tree. This function provides additional contextual navigation support.

functions.name: local_jobboard_get_required_doctypes_for_applicant
functions.description: Get required document types for an applicant based on their profile. This function filters document types based on: Gender condition (e.g., libreta_militar only for men), Profession exemptions (e.g., tarjeta_profesional not for licenciados), ISER exemption status (documents already in file for previous ISER employees), and Age exemption (e.g., libreta_militar exempt for 50+ years).

parameters.name: gender
parameters.description: The applicant's gender (M, F, O, N).

parameters.name: educationlevel
parameters.description: DEPRECATED - No longer used. Kept for backward compatibility.

parameters.name: isiserexempted
parameters.description: Whether the applicant is ISER exempted.

parameters.name: userage
parameters.description: The applicant's age in years (for age exemptions).

functions.return_description: Array of document type objects that are required for this applicant.
